title: Thawing iPSC Plate
author: Celeste M M. Karch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x8ufrww
materials: Determine which clones to expand based on screening.

steps.title: Coat 24-well Plate
steps.instruction: Coat a 24-well plate with Matrigel and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 250-300 ul Matrigel per well (1 well per well, from 96 well).

steps.title: Thaw iPSC Plate
steps.instruction: Remove the plate from the -80 °C Styrofoam box and monitor thawing.

substeps.instruction: Check on plate after 00:15:00 to avoid over-thawing.

steps.title: Plate Cells
steps.instruction: Add mTesR1 supplemented with 10 uM Rock inhibitor to each well and plate the cells using one of two methods.

substeps.instruction: Option A: Remove desired cells from appropriate wells, transfer to 1.7 mL tube, spin off freezing media, and plate cells in 24-well plate.
Option B: Remove desired cells from appropriate wells, dilute 1:5 (final volume of 500uL) in mTesR1, and plate in 24-well plate.
